title: Trouble building Assimp in Visual Studio from CMake subdirectory

labels.name: Build

body:
**Describe the bug**
I have Assimp as a git submodule in my project and I'm trying to write a CMakeLists.txt that lets me build Assimp and link it with my application. Assimp builds successfully when I do an out-of-source build in the repo with the Visual Studio 16 2019 generator on Windows 10. However when I add the assimp repo as a subdirectory in CMakeLists.txt, CMake generates the VS project, but the build fails with the following errors.

```
Error   C1083   Cannot open include file: 'draco/draco_features.h': No such file or directory (compiling source file D:\projects\temp\new-meng\vendor\assimp\code\AssetLib\glTF2\glTF2Importer.cpp) assimp  D:\projects\temp\new-meng\vendor\assimp\contrib\draco\src\draco\core\macros.h   19
Error   C1083   Cannot open include file: 'draco/draco_features.h': No such file or directory (compiling source file D:\projects\temp\new-meng\vendor\assimp\code\AssetLib\glTF2\glTF2Exporter.cpp) assimp  D:\projects\temp\new-meng\vendor\assimp\contrib\draco\src\draco\core\macros.h   19
Error   LNK1104 cannot open file '..\..\lib\Debug\assimp-vc142-mtd.lib' assimp_cmd  D:\projects\temp\new-meng\build\vendor\assimp\tools\assimp_cmd\LINK 1
Error   LNK1104 cannot open file '..\lib\Debug\assimp-vc142-mtd.lib'    unit    D:\projects\temp\new-meng\build\vendor\assimp\test\LINK 1
```

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a project repo.

```
mkdir project
cd project
git init
```

2. Add Assimp as a submodule in vendor/assimp

```
git submodule add https://github.com/assimp/assimp.git vendor/assimp
```

3. Add a CMakeLists.txt file to the project with the following contents.

```cmake
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(project)

add_subdirectory(vendor/assimp)
```

4. Run CMake for an out-of-source build with the Visual Studio 16 2019 generator.

```
mkdir build
cd build
cmake -G "Visual Studio 16 2019" ..
```

5. Build the Visual Studio solution.
6. See the above errors.

**Expected behavior**
CMake generates a project for my application that includes the assimp target and successfully builds.

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Windows 10 Pro
 - CMake Version: 3.20.0-rc1
 - Assimp commit: 26ebeaea5cb92f841fc5e2da9da379718223e831

**Additional context**

I was able to build successfully by disabling the draco target with
```cmake
set(ASSIMP_BUILD_DRACO OFF CACHE BOOL "..." FORCE )
```

My [post](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/66286971/trouble-building-assimp-in-visual-studio-from-cmake-subdirectory) on StackOverflow.
